ns2:course.label: Program Foundations
ns2:course.description: This is the first course of the University of Illinois iMBA degree and is taken concurrently with a student’s first course(s) during their iMBA program. Students will develop connections to the program and have a firm understanding of program and academic expectations upon course completion. These skills will then be applied to the iMBA coursework in order for students to be successful. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: iMBA students are expected to enroll in this course during their first term in the program. Concurrent enrollment with other courses is expected. Limited to iMBA students in their first enrollment term.
